_comment: The zipped packages of maps. Each package is one zip with the game plus its own maps. 'maps' are config.js entries (a file name, or {id, file, scope, name, blurb}). 'title' replaces the game's title in lang/en.json for this package. A package with no maps is skipped until it has some.

maps.name: World: UN countries
maps.blurb: Find the 193 UN member countries, plus Vatican City and Palestine

maps.name: World: all countries, territories and islands
maps.blurb: Find every country, territory and island of the world, including the small ones
